reason: Reviewed lifecycle hooks, the Notifai skill, harness setup, CLI readiness, and domain terms after setting additionalContextLimit 0 on the Codex SessionStart handler. Codex spills hook additionalContext above roughly 2,500 tokens to a preview file and shows the model that preview plus a path; Notifai's activation context may reach 24,000 bytes, so Codex agents could read a truncated preview instead of the effective guidance. The guidance wording is unchanged; what changed is that Codex now receives it whole, which is why this is guidance-updated rather than reviewed-no-impact. Codex hashes the new field, so an existing Codex installation needs one /hooks re-approval; the shipped skill already states that migrating an older Codex definition costs one unavoidable /hooks approval, so no skill text changed. codexHookIdentityHash mirrors the field and omits Codex's 2,500 default so an explicit default still matches. Agent-facing commands, readiness JSON, harness-setup recovery, and domain language are otherwise unchanged; the CLI and stable hook adapter remain the only runtime authority and npx skills remains skill-install authority.
